approach: Find the time of flight from the cart's speed and distance moved, then use it as the projectile's up-and-down time to find launch speed relative to the cart.

steps.text: The cart moves at constant speed 30 ms⁻¹ and covers 80 m while the projectile is in the air. Find the time of flight.
Relative to the cart, the projectile only moves vertically: straight up and back down to the same point on the cart. This is the usual vertical time of flight.
Solve for the vertical launch speed relative to the cart.
